searchText: Tested this release with Nimbus. Tests all pass on our glamsterdam-devnet-8 branch. And I can now fully enable comparison of generated guest input and resulting output thanks to the progressive lists changes and the fix related to extraData.

excerpts.author: deme1744
excerpts.content:
Tested this release with Nimbus. Tests all pass on our glamsterdam-devnet-8 branch.

And I can now fully enable comparison of generated guest input and resulting output thanks to the progressive lists changes and the fix related to extraData.
